question: Where was the central celebration of Parakram Diwas, held in January 2025, to mark Subhas Chandra Bose's 128th birth anniversary?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Barabati Fort, Cuttack, Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The central celebration of **Parakram Diwas** to mark the 128th birth anniversary of Subhas Chandra Bose was held at **Barabati Fort, Cuttack, Odisha** in January 2025.
 
• **Parakram Diwas** is observed annually on January 23rd to honor the birth anniversary of **Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose**, one of India’s most prominent freedom fighters.
 
• **Cuttack, Odisha**, is the birthplace of Subhas Chandra Bose, making it a historically significant location for this celebration.
 
• The event included cultural programs, exhibitions, and tributes to commemorate Netaji's contributions to India’s independence struggle.
 
• Barabati Fort, a historical site in Cuttack, served as a symbolic venue for this national event, emphasizing Netaji's connection to the region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Subhas Chandra Bose**

 
 
• Born on January 23, 1897, in Cuttack, Odisha, Bose is remembered for his role in India's freedom struggle.
 
• He was the founder of the **Indian National Army (INA)**, which sought to overthrow British rule in India.
 
• He was famously referred to as **"Netaji"**, meaning "Respected Leader".
 
• His famous slogan "**Give me blood, and I will give you freedom**" inspired countless Indians to join the independence movement.
 
 
 
• **Parakram Diwas**
 
 
• Introduced by the Government of India in 2021, the day is celebrated to inspire citizens with the spirit of patriotism.
 
• The announcement of this day was part of the 125th birth anniversary celebration of Subhas Chandra Bose.
 
• The day sees national-level programs, speeches, and events dedicated to Netaji’s legacy.
 
 
 
• **Barabati Fort**
 
 
• Located in Cuttack, Odisha, the Barabati Fort is a 14th-century fort built by the Ganga dynasty.
 
• The fort is of immense historical and cultural significance, symbolizing Odisha's rich heritage.
 
• Its selection as the venue for Parakram Diwas highlights the historical connection of the region to Subhas Chandra Bose.
 
 
 
• **Netaji's Legacy**
 
 
• Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose's efforts focused on uniting Indians across communities to fight for independence.
 
• He strongly believed in the concept of armed resistance against colonial rule.
 
• His leadership of the INA and his collaboration with Axis powers during World War II remain topics of extensive discussion and research.
